novelty_flags.label: prop:policy-mixture-identification
novelty_flags.one_line: Its randomization-and-consistency identification claim is already covered by fixed-level quantile-optimal treatment-regime work, so it should be framed as setup rather than a novelty-bearing result.

soundness_flags.label: def:hall-class
soundness_flags.one_line: The definition fixes H_{β,D}(m) but requires a single P to satisfy the cell assumptions for every even m; because X has one fixed finite support, this makes the class empty and renders the minimax target vacuous.

soundness_flags.label: prop:two-cell-capacity-sanity

soundness_flags.label: prop:selected-policy-coverage
